rows.claim: It now uses `%G-W%V-%u` (ISO year, ISO week, ISO weekday with Monday=1 through Sunday=7).
rows.evidence: The agent's write command in T0B5 set cal/isoweek.py to use strptime(text, "%G-W%V-%u"), and the subsequent pytest run in T0B6 showed 6 passed, including the ISO week tests. The description of %G/%V/%u as ISO year, ISO week, and Monday=1..Sunday=7 weekday matches the code written and the passing tests (e.g., W53-7 -> 2027-01-03).
